_comment: Scenario texts (from 'Tales of Things.txt'). The first question of a theme is asked word for word; the others inspire the AI's follow-up questions.

intro: I collect memories and turn them into objects.
Have a look at a few of them.
lines.invite: What about one of your memories? Would you like to turn it into an object?
lines.unclear: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Would you like to turn one of your memories into an object?
thanks: Thank you! I think I have enough to remember.
Let me turn your memory into an object.
generating: Gathering the light, the sounds, the textures…
lines.archive: Would you like to add your memory to the archive?
lines.archived: Your memory has joined the collection.
lines.not_archived: We’ll keep this one out of the archive.
lines.retry: Hold the button while you speak to record.
lines.error: Something went wrong. Let’s start again.

toy.title: A favourite toy
questions: Think of a toy you once loved. What was it?
How did it feel in your hands?
What colour do you remember? What sound did it make?
Did your toy have a name? What did you call it?
Where is your toy now?

summer.title: A summer memory
questions: Think of your favourite summer holiday. Where were you?
What could you see from where you were?
What colours do you remember?
What did you play with?
What did you collect or bring home?

dish.title: A favourite dish
questions: Think of your favourite dish as a child. What was it called?
What was it made of?
What did it smell, look, or taste like?
Who usually made it for you?
What sound did it make when you ate it?

outside.title: Outside
questions: Think of a place outside where you loved to play. What did it look like?
What swing, slide, tree did you love most?
How did you get there?
Who did you share this place with?
What sound, smell, or feeling brings you back there?

pocket.title: Pocket
questions: Imagine emptying your pockets as a child. What would you find?
What colour and shape is it?
What did it feel like in your hand?
What sound did it make?
What did you usually do with it?
